Actor Ram Kapoor Sparks Controversy Over Comments on Infidelity

Actor Ram Kapoor's remarks on infidelity during the reality show 'Lock Upp' have drawn significant online criticism. Kapoor suggested that cheating can occur by mistake, a statement that has been met with backlash. His co-contestant Akanksha Chamola, who has confirmed her divorce, has publicly disagreed with his views on the matter.
